shared_elements: hand with splayed fingers rendered in low relief
curving parallel-line incisions used to render texture (mane/hair)
animal or figure shown in profile
justification: Both are low-relief carvings that include a splayed hand rendered with incised fingers and use repetitive parallel incisions to indicate hair or fur, but A depicts a quadruped/lion-like beast in blocky, heavily schematic high relief while B depicts a bearded human head in profile with a fillet headband, elaborate curled beard rendered in rows of dotted curls, and a wing or feathered element behind. The subjects, their relationships and the degree of naturalism and detail are essentially different, so only generic correspondences remain.
